name: @video-workbench/desktop
description: Desktop preview using the shared managed chengfeng-videocut Runtime
author: 成峰 / AI产品自由

scripts.prepare: bun run build:runtime && bun run prepare:resources
scripts.typecheck: node --check main.mjs && node --check managed-runtime.mjs && node --check runtime.mjs && node --check prepare-resources.mjs && node --check smoke-lib.mjs && node --check smoke.mjs && node --check packaged-smoke.mjs && node --check managed-packaged-smoke.mjs
scripts.dist:dir: bun run prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: bun run prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.dist:win: bun run prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
